summary:
Complete implementation plan addressing:
1. School Account Authentication (Student login with school Google/email accounts).
2. Database Architecture (Firestore) for student profiles, persistent chat logs, and real-time Counselor Risk Flagged logs.
3. n8n AI Chatbot Webhook Pipeline for Cali, Casti, and Cedi with live fallback.
4. Counselor View Dashboard with PIN/Role security, mandatory privacy & human escalation disclaimer, and triage action buttons.
5. AI Dependency Engine enforcing the 12+ message / 15-minute de-escalation protocol and grounding modal.
